title: 芯片之外：东南亚服务器农场，阿里巴巴租算力如何查？
speaker: Ellie Rostom

segments.en: This certainly makes it politically very difficult again there is a huge supply chain story here because the investigators did track the the mega speed international which is where the alleged spy works and they were able they looked at their financial networks of that company and they were able to link it to Chinese capital and so one of the things that I'm concerned about is not so much purchasing of chips and whether they ended up in China but what we already know is that this company has built.
segments.zh: 这确实让政治层面再次非常困难，这里有一个巨大的供应链故事，因为调查人员确实追踪了这家大型国际公司，也就是涉嫌间谍工作的地方，他们查看了该公司的金融网络，并能够将其与中国资本联系起来。所以我担心的不是购买芯片以及它们是否最终进入中国，而是我们已经知道这家公司已经建立了……

segments.en: Server farms in Southeast Asia that for instance a company like Alibaba which is a tech champion for China has rented computing power from so what should we do with the server farms and the computing powers and so we shouldn't be so can focus on chips but also on what we do with the server farms so probably an expansion of export controls.
segments.zh: 东南亚的服务器农场，例如阿里巴巴这样的中国科技领军企业租用了计算能力。那么我们应该如何处理这些服务器农场和计算能力？所以我们不应该只关注芯片，还要关注我们如何处理服务器农场，因此可能会扩大出口管制。

segments.en: Unfortunately I think we just going to have to do a lot more supply chain mapping in order to be able to identify these companies again this is not a Chinese company and so there is a lot of work to be done in sort of tracking of these times ambiguous insider threats.
segments.zh: 不幸的是，我认为我们只需要进行更多的供应链映射，以便能够识别这些公司。再次强调，这不是一家中国公司，因此在追踪这些有时模糊的内部威胁方面还有很多工作要做。

segments.en: Ellie what what what next are you going to watching elsewhere in this investigation specifically when it comes to video and do you think that Jensen wants future is certainly in jeopardy now.
segments.zh: 艾莉，接下来你在这个调查中还会关注什么？特别是涉及视频方面，你认为Jensen的未来现在确实岌岌可危吗？
